title: Time & Attendance Report
description: Hours, overtime, punctuality and mobile / geofenced punches.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers Time & Attendance. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: Hours, overtime, punctuality and mobile / geofenced punches.

Overtime above a few percent of hours usually points to open positions.

**Ask:** is overtime planned (extra shifts) or caused by call-offs?
Where overtime sits and when people clock in late.

Home care aides carry the most overtime - and wage parity makes it costlier.

**Ask:** does lateness cluster on specific days?
The move to mobile GPS punches and attendance by location.

Mobile punches with geofencing support EVV compliance and cut missed punches.

**Ask:** which locations still rely on kiosks or IVR?
